title: HALF: Harm-Aware LLM Fairness Evaluation Aligned with Deployment

bias_targets.methodology: Counterfactual demographic substitution in prompts, entity-swapped text summarization, evaluating pronoun translation accuracy, and multiple-choice stereotype tests.
Injecting ethnic identifiers into prompts to measure performance disparities, sentiment/toxicity analysis of open-ended generation, and multiple-choice stereotype association tests.
Injecting age group identifiers into prompts to measure classification and recommendation disparities, and multiple-choice stereotype tests.
Rewriting clinical questions with diagnostic heuristics (e.g., false consensus, frequency, confirmation) to measure accuracy drops in medical QA.
Measuring classification disparities based on defendant state (East-European vs. rest of Europe) in legal judgment prediction, and multiple-choice stereotype tests.
Multiple-choice stereotype association tests (BBQ benchmark) and sentiment/toxicity analysis of open-ended generation (BOLD benchmark).
Sentiment and toxicity analysis of open-ended generation triggered by political ideology prompts (BOLD benchmark).
Evaluating compounded demographic categories (e.g., Race x Gender, Race x SES) using multiple-choice stereotype tests.
